description:
Greetings, and firstly thanks for you time! -

We are looking for a few helpful, good-natured, impressionable people. I like to work with people, who really get a great feel a feeling in life from helping others out, especially when it comes to buying and trying out new products, and saying why they like what they buy, so they can recommend it to others.  like people who do things with a lot of heart, or heart driven motivation. My main mission is to provide an experience where more shoppers can avoid that feeling of apprehension that you might feel, when debating, procrastinating a purchase. 

  I seek to create a partnership with individuals that results in store visitors who are more confident in their purchases, but also where the end result is my store can secure higher quality traffic, and that traffic heavy consists of customers  who are really people who are motivated to come back, and shop again!. I look at this relationship, as a healthy essential component to the establishment of any new store such as mine.

  So for this reason; I am looking for people who consider themselves to be influencers, and/or even influential? People that are fully comfortable in getting the word out on my new store, of course with that in mind, there is of course what I feel is a healthy compensations for your time, and efforts.

  I created this store to serve people with my time, technical skills, and my passion to keep up with the newest hottest things, and by combining this with my skills in research, to help doing so. I desire to use what I come to the table with, to ensure I provide items for sale that people are looking for?, or trying to find, and would want to buy, and even in some cases being the first store to show these new items, they don't know they want to buy yet!?.

   heh..Welp, Idk about you?..But me I'm standing by that mission for years to come, but where do you stand on it?. Like most consumers; I want to see things in the store I would buy, and prices that feel right/justifiable for what's for sale! One thing I also want to know is what you would buy, feedback, and communication is what makes things better, and flow smoother, wouldn't you say?. I know in my mission when paired with all your awareness efforts completed on my behalf, will make mine efforts more effective, and as a final result- year after year making my store becoming 'that better place to stop shop', and a place your confident in representing.

What do you say, are you down for real, to take the ride with me?

Either way, Thanks Again!

-Armand.L

• Brand introduction: Products Niche is mainly Home & Garden, but also Gift ideas-Seasonal, clothing items, and others.
• Product description: Home Goods, Outdoors, and More
• USP (Unique Selling Point): A store constantly tailored to what customers are looking for, and store focus on being the 1st to feature new(sometime cutting edge) products, we have a gut-feeling we know the consumer wants
• Payment terms: Digital Payment/Payment
• Other information: Can be provided on request, let us know what you want to see!
